meta.title: World electricity generation by fuel (Ember)
meta.description: Annual electricity generation in TWh per country and fuel (coal, gas, other fossil, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar, bioenergy, other renewables, total), plus the world aggregate (code WLD), compiled by Ember's yearly full release and republished here under GEOM attestation. Points are [year, TWh] pairs.
sources: Ember, Yearly electricity data (yearly full release long format, ember-energy.org)
meta.cadence: annual with in-year revisions · window 2015 onward
